drafts.title: Registrar abuse report to Tucows Domains Inc.
drafts.subject: Phishing / brand impersonation: wallet-meteorwallet.com impersonates Meteor Wallet
drafts.body:
DRAFT - NOT FILED. File only after the brand owner approves it and has signed a Letter of Authorisation.

Hello Tucows Domains Inc. abuse team,

The domain wallet-meteorwallet[.]com (registered with you on 2026-10-26) is being used to impersonate Meteor Wallet, a crypto project whose official site is hxxps://meteorwallet[.]app. We ask you to suspend the domain under your abuse policy and the RAA section 3.18 obligations.

Evidence (observed 2026-11-01, read-only, URLs defanged):
- URL: hxxps://wallet-meteorwallet[.]com/
- Brand name plus a phishing lure word
- Page title resembles the official title (80%)
- Brand named on the page (5x)
- Mentions seed phrase (no input form seen)
- Lure text: Airdrop, rewards
- Resolves to 188.114.97.11, 188.114.96.11
- Page title: "Meteor Wallet – Secure NEAR Crypto Wallet for Web3"
- Screenshot: shots/wallet-meteorwallet.com.jpg (attach)

We are not affiliated with the operator of wallet-meteorwallet[.]com. Meteor Wallet has not authorised its use of the brand. Screenshots and HTML captures are available on request.

Regards,
{{REPORTER_NAME}}
{{REPORTER_ORG}}, acting for Meteor Wallet under a Letter of Authorisation dated {{LOA_DATE}}
{{REPORTER_EMAIL}}
